name: Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan
benefit: - **Interest Subsidy Assistance:** 100% interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10,00,000/- for the moratorium period (course duration + 1 year).
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must have passed HSC (Higher Secondary Certificate) with at least 60 percentile. 1. The applicant must have taken an education loan from a recognized bank for pursuing higher education in India or abroad. 1. The applicant must have a family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/- per year.
